name: sharepoint-sandbox
description: Policy-bound SharePoint lifecycle authoring for one trusted site.
long_description: A trusted local MCP server for inspecting and authoring one human-configured SharePoint Online site, with optional human-scoped Power Automate and evidence modules. Microsoft credentials remain in the local process. The extension exposes typed operations and deliberately provides no site selector, generic Graph/HTTP/PowerShell execution, configuration mutation, or token access.

tools.name: site_get_info
tools.description: Get the immutable configured SharePoint sandbox identity and metadata.

tools.name: site_inventory
tools.description: Inventory supported artifacts in the configured SharePoint sandbox.

tools.name: site_apply_blueprint
tools.description: Validate and idempotently apply a declarative site blueprint, with dry-run support.

tools.name: page_get
tools.description: Read one modern page and its typed canvas from the configured site.

tools.name: get_configured_scope
tools.description: Read the immutable capability and resource-alias policy without credentials.

tools.name: flow_get_status
tools.description: Report whether the separately scoped Power Automate backend is configured and authenticated.
